headers.description: Optional for the public discovery tools (get_service_info, search_business, check_response_rate). For the business tools, connect via OAuth (recommended, plug-and-play; discovered from the endpoint's .well-known/oauth-protected-resource) OR send a per-business bearer token (format: sragt_...) as: Authorization: Bearer sragt_...
